summary: Root-level reset. A targeted serum that balances sebum production, reduces flaking, and fosters an optimal environment for hair growth.
description: Scientific scalp architecture. This pre-wash treatment uses exfoliating acids and antimicrobial extracts to dissolve follicular buildup and soothe inflammation, restoring the scalp's delicate microbiome.
technical_overview: Offered at $32.0 for 50ml, this KoColor SCALP_TREATMENT is expertly formulated with Salicylic Acid, Tea Tree Oil, and Niacinamide. It delivers a high-fidelity Clear Serum color profile (`#F0FFF0`) and leverages keratolytic exfoliation.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Section dry, unwashed hair and apply directly to the scalp. Massage and let sit for 10 minutes before shampooing.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Use a silicone scalp massager during application to manually break up hardened sebum plugs.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Lipophilic salicylic acid penetrates deep into the lipid-rich environment of the hair follicle to dissolve blockages from the inside out.
